How this works

For MRIIRS and MRU, NEXZO starts from the verified official Manav Rachna domain, discovers relevant event / student-life / club pages, and fetches current public results through the NEXZO backend. Each result keeps its source link. NEXZO does not claim access to a private college ERP, and it does not invent an event when no reliable result is found.
